text.id: Kita nyampe pas badainya udah lewat. Langit robek-robek, dan di sela-selanya ada garis oranye yang rendah banget, kayak ada yang lupa matiin lampu.
text.en: We arrive just as the storm passes. The sky is torn to pieces, and between the pieces there's a low orange band, like someone forgot to switch off a light.

text.id: Dermaga kayu. Bakau di kiri. Kapal biru-putih diiket di ujung. Gue udah pernah lihat tempat ini. Di layar HP Sekar, jam lima kurang dua.
text.en: A wooden jetty. Mangroves on the left. A blue and white boat tied at the end. I've seen this place before. On Sekar's screen, at two minutes to five.

text.id: Polisi belum dateng. Speedboat Bentang belum dateng. Cuma ada satu lampu, digantung di tiang ujung dermaga.
text.en: The police haven't come. Bentang's speedboat hasn't come. There's only one lamp, hanging from a post at the end of the jetty.

text.id: Di bawah lampu itu ada orang berdiri. Rambutnya setengah diiket. Jaket hijau tentara yang kegedean. Headphone di leher.
text.en: Someone is standing under that lamp. Hair tied half up. An oversized army-green jacket. Headphones round her neck.

text.id: Klik. Klik.{w} Gue aman. Lanjut rekam.
text.en: Click. Click.{w} I'm okay. Keep rolling.

text.id: Setahun telat. Satu dermaga jauhnya.{w} Gue mulai jalan.
text.en: A year late. One jetty away.{w} I start walking.
